description: This file defines the InflateStream class, which is a stream decorator implementing the StreamInterface for inflating compressed stream data (gzip, deflate). It handles reading gzip headers, setting up a stream filter with zlib.inflate, and wrapping the resulting resource back into a Guzzle stream object.

classes.name: InflateStream
classes.description: A stream decorator that uses PHP's zlib.inflate filter to inflate deflate or gzipped content by processing the underlying stream and handling gzip headers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that reads gzip header, skips the header, adds zlib.inflate stream filter, and wraps the resource as a Guzzle stream.

methods.name: getLengthOfPossibleFilenameHeader
methods.description: Determines the length of a filename header in a gzip stream if present, reading until a null byte.
